title: Add SoloForge AI to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [SoloForge AI](https://soloforge-ai-web.onrender.com) to build
- SoloForge AI is an AI Creator OS that turns content ideas into generated assets, review queues, and automated publishing workflows. It uses Pollinations for AI image generation, authenticated AI sessi

Fixes #15915

gist.headline: Ideas get a workbench
gist.blurb: SoloForge AI joins the build catalog with a place for content ideas to become assets, pass through a review queue, and head toward publishing. Pollinations makes the images along the way.
gist.summary: Adds SoloForge AI to the build app listing, connecting content ideas to generated assets, review queues, and automated publishing workflows with Pollinations image generation.
gist.impact: Creators get a workflow for moving an idea through asset creation and review toward publishing, rather than keeping those steps in separate tabs.
gist.visual_concept: SoloForge AI is a creator workspace, with no mascot or logo specified. Depict a cozy workbench where an idea card becomes an image, moves to a review tray, then follows a path toward a publishing mailbox; Polli, wearing a tiny editor’s visor, helps sort the cards among code-plants.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art creator’s workshop, an idea card becomes a little generated picture, passes through a review tray, and follows a path toward a publishing mailbox; lime green (#ecf874) glows from the workbench, with mint and peach gradients, warm cream walls, and code-plants nearby.
